items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after a meal went with a rise about 3.2 mg/dL smaller in real adults. Walking 10 to 19 minutes got most of the gain, with a rise about 17.5 mg/dL smaller.

items.title: Keep dinner early
items.text: Only 12.5% of your dinners started at 8 pm or later, which is a good thing since sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners. Keeping dinner before 8 pm is a good idea.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Your overnight fast averaged 10.1 hours, which is a good start. In the program, adding an overnight fast to coaching changed the score by -0.03 points compared to coaching alone.
